description: This file defines the UniformIntegerDistribution class, which implements a discrete uniform distribution over a specified integer range, providing methods for probability calculation, cumulative probability, statistical measures, and random sampling.

classes.name: UniformIntegerDistribution
classes.description: Implements a uniform distribution over integers with inclusive lower and upper bounds, providing probability, cumulative probability, mean, variance, and sampling functions.

methods.name: probability
methods.description: Returns the probability mass function value for a given integer x.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Returns the cumulative distribution function value at integer x.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Computes the mean of the distribution.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Computes the variance of the distribution.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the support.

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the support.

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Indicates the support is connected (continuous range).

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates a random sample within the distribution bounds.
